title: How often you should bluff depends on one thing
hook: How often should you bluff? Almost everyone gets this wrong, and it depends on one thing.
caption:
How often should you bluff? It depends on bet size: half pot {gto_half}, pot {gto_pot}, double pot {gto_2x}. Less is predictable, more is donating.

Educational content about decision theory and probability. We do not encourage gambling.

scenes.say: How often should you bluff? Almost everyone gets this wrong, and it depends on one thing.
Bet size. The bigger the bet, the more reasons they need to call, and the more you can bluff.

scenes.big_label: when you bet double the pot

scenes.say: Bluff less and you're predictable. Bluff more and you're donating.
There's no right bluff rate. There's a right one for every bet size.

takeaway: There's no right bluff rate. There's a right one for every bet size.
